response.overview: One thousand Minecraft players are divided between two vastly different islands: one a resource-rich paradise, the other a barren and dangerous wasteland. With no predetermined society or objectives, the players are left to build communities, establish governments, form alliances, trade, survive, and compete for resources.  As the days pass, the experiment develops into sprawling story of civilization, inequality, migration, conflict, betrayal, cooperation, and survival. What begins as a social experiment gradually evolves into an unexpected struggle between two societies shaped by radically different circumstances.
response.title: 1000 Players Simulate  Civilization: Rich & Poor
